items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Ken. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I was staying at a hotel and anytime anybody had any jams, the guy would look me up at the hotel and call me up.

ctx.x: It was in the middle of the depression you know. But we -- (inaudible). Well you see -- I met Chuck too down there -- he used to go down there to dance.
